# Identification of Nerves -- COMPUTE STEP (historical)
==================================================
# ============================================================
# NOTE ON RE-RUNNING: this script produces nerveID.csv, which assigns
# NerveID/Invaded/BorderInvaded/NerveProximal to every spot. These
# assignments are NOT guaranteed deterministic across environments or
# package versions (hclust/cutree numbering can shift with tiny
# numerical differences), and once nerveID.csv has been used to
# generate images sent for pathologist review, the specific ID numbers
# in that file must NOT change -- re-running this script could silently
# renumber nerves and break the correspondence with the pathologist's
# annotations.
#
# DO NOT RE-RUN THIS SCRIPT unless you are deliberately changing the
# identification method (thresholds, clustering approach, etc.) AND are
# prepared to redo pathologist review against new IDs. For everyday work
# (checking/regenerating figures), use
# nerve_identification_figures_cleaned.Rmd instead, which loads the
# nerveID.csv this script produces and never recomputes it.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Tables (output/03_nerve_identification/tables/):
#   - nerveID.csv
#       CRITICAL HANDOFF FILE. Full colData(spe) with NerveID, Invaded,
#       is.nerve, BorderID, BorderInvaded, NerveProximal added. Feeds
#       into 04_DE_analysis, which builds DE_SPE_annotaion.csv from it
#       (the file every other script in this project depends on).
# ============================================================

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(scuttle)
library(batchelor)
library(scran)
library(scater)
library(bluster)
library(ggspavis)
library(dplyr)
library(RcppML)
library(ggrepel)
library(BayesSpace)
library(RANN)
library(plyr)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=14))
library(irlba)

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")
SCRIPTS_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "scripts")

NMF_VIZ_TABLES_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", "02_NMF_visualization", "tables")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "03_nerve_identification"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
dir.create(TABLES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(SCRIPTS_DIR, "general_functions.R"))

spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode

compk30 <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(NMF_VIZ_TABLES_DIR, "NMFcomp.csv")))
names(compk30)[names(compk30) == "Myeloid.Macrophages."] <- "Myeloid(Macrophages)"
names(compk30)[names(compk30) == "Myeloid.C1q_macrophages."] <- "Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)"
rownames(compk30) <- compk30$barcode
```

```{r}
# ---- Extract NMF-derived signals -----------------------------------------
comp <- as.matrix(t(reducedDims(spe)[["compk30"]]))
spe$nerve <- comp['Nerve',]
spe$tumor <- comp['Ductal_malignant',]
spe$C1qM <- comp['Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)',]
```

```{r}
# ---- Threshold for calling nerves (>20% nerve signal) --------------------
spe$is.nerve <- spe$nerve > 20
```

```{r}
# ---- Group into individual nerves (NerveID via spatial clustering) -------
# Shift Coordinates so hclust/cutree doesn't connect nerves across samples
spe$col <- spe$array_col
spe$row <- spe$array_row

offset_row <- 150
offset_col <- 250

for (i in seq_along(unique(spe$sample_id))) {
  off_row <- offset_row * i-1
  off_col <- offset_col * i-1
  smp <- unique(spe$sample_id)[i]
  spe$col[spe$sample_id==smp] <- spe$col[spe$sample_id==smp] + off_col
  spe$row[spe$sample_id==smp] <- spe$row[spe$sample_id==smp] + off_row
}

spe_nerve <- spe[,spe$is.nerve]
pos <- cbind(spe_nerve$row,spe_nerve$col)
nn <- BayesSpace:::find_neighbors(pos,radius=2,method="manhattan")
dd <- dist(pos,method="manhattan")
tree <- hclust(dd,method="single")
spe_nerve$NerveID <- cutree(tree,h=2)
add <- data.frame(colData(spe_nerve)[,c("barcode","NerveID")])
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(dplyr::left_join(data.frame(colData(spe)),add))

# Only consider nerves covered by at least 2 spots
setna <- as.integer(names(which(table(spe$NerveID)<2)))
spe$NerveID[spe$NerveID %in% setna] <- NA
```

```{r}
# ---- Threshold for Invaded vs NonInvaded (mean tumor contribution >1%) ---
pd <- data.frame(colData(spe))
pd <- pd[!is.na(pd$NerveID),]
pd <- dplyr::group_by(pd, NerveID)
pd <- dplyr::mutate(pd, mnTumor = mean(tumor, na.rm = TRUE))
pd <- dplyr::ungroup(pd)
pd <- pd[!duplicated(pd$NerveID),]

pd$Invaded <- pd$mnTumor > 1
add <- pd[,c("NerveID","mnTumor","Invaded")]
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(dplyr::left_join(data.frame(colData(spe)),add))
spe$Invaded <- ifelse(spe$Invaded,"Invaded","NonInvaded")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ---- Identify direct-contact border spots (nneighbors=2) -----------------
getContacts <- function(input,rad,knn,query=rownames(input),graph=FALSE,x="pxl_col_in_fullres",y="pxl_row_in_fullres") {
    require(RANN)
    require(Matrix)
    require(igraph)
    query.data <- input[query,c(x,y)]
    nn <- nn2(data=input[,c(x,y)],query=query.data,k=knn,radius=rad,searchtype="radius")
    if (!graph) {
    nn.ct <- apply(nn[["nn.idx"]], 1, function(ROW) {
        tmp <- sapply(ROW,function(ELEMENT) {
               out <- NA
               if(ELEMENT!=0) {
               out <- input$Cluster[ELEMENT]
               }
               return(out)
                   })
        return(unlist(tmp))
    })

    expected <- unique(input$Cluster)
    out.list <- lapply(1:ncol(nn.ct),function(COL) {
        contacts <- nn.ct[,COL]
        contacts <- contacts[-1]
        tbbl <- table("Contact_Celltype"=contacts)
        freq <- as.data.frame(tbbl)
        mssng <- setdiff(expected,freq$Contact_Celltype)
        if (length(mssng)>0) {
        add  <- data.frame("Contact_Celltype"=mssng,
                   "Freq"=rep(0,length(mssng)))
        freq <- rbind(freq,add)
        }
        freq$barcode <- input[query,"barcode"][COL]
        freq$Cluster <- input[query,"Cluster"][COL]
        return(freq)
    })
    out.contacts <- do.call(rbind,out.list)
    return(as.data.frame(out.contacts))
    }else {
    indx.knn <- nn[["nn.idx"]]
    m.adj <- Matrix(0, nrow=nrow(indx.knn), ncol=nrow(indx.knn), sparse=TRUE) 
    rownames(m.adj) <- colnames(m.adj) <- rownames(indx.knn) <- rownames(input) <- input$barcode

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(m.adj))) {
        m.adj[i,rownames(indx.knn)[indx.knn[i,]]] <- 1
    }
    diag(m.adj) <- 0
    igr <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(m.adj)
    igr <- set_vertex_attr(igr,name="Cluster",value = unlist(input[names(V(igr)),"Cluster"]))
    out <- data.frame()
    for (ct in unique(input$Cluster)) {
        vs <- V(igr)$name[V(igr)$Cluster==ct]
        egds <- unlist(lapply(adjacent_vertices(igr,v=vs),names))
        if (length(egds)==0) {
        tmp <- data.frame("Edges"=0,
                  "From"=ct,
                  "To"=unique(input$Cluster))
        } else {
        tbbl <- table(input[egds,"Cluster"])
        tmp <- data.frame("Edges"=as.numeric(unname(tbbl)),
                  "From"=ct,
                  "To"=names(tbbl))
        }
        mssng <- setdiff(unique(input$Cluster),tmp$To)
        if (length(mssng)>0) {
        add  <- data.frame("From"=ct,
                   "To"=mssng,
                   "Edges"=0)
        tmp <- rbind(tmp,add)
        }
        out <- rbind(out,tmp)
    }
    return(out)
    }
}

out <- list()
nneighbors <- 2
rd <- nneighbors * 23
kn <- (nneighbors * 6) + 1
input <- data.frame(spatialCoords(spe))
input$barcode <- spe$barcode
input$Cluster <- spe$NerveID
input$sample_id <- spe$sample_id

for (smp in unique(input$sample_id)) {
  inp <- input[input$sample_id == smp,]
  cons <- getContacts(input=inp,rad=rd,knn=kn)
  cons <- cons[is.na(cons$Cluster) & !is.na(cons$Contact_Celltype),]
  cons <- cons[cons$Freq>0,]
  cons <- cons[!duplicated(cons$barcode),]
  out[[smp]] <- data.frame("barcode"=cons$barcode,
                           "BorderID"=cons$Contact_Celltype,
                           "sample_id"=smp
  )
}

add <- Reduce(rbind,out)
add$BorderInvaded <- plyr::mapvalues(add$BorderID,spe$NerveID,spe$Invaded,warn_missing =FALSE)

add <- select(add,-sample_id)
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(dplyr::left_join(data.frame(colData(spe)),add),by="barcode")
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode
```

```{r,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ---- Identify the broader nerve-proximal zone (nneighbors=100) -----------
out <- list()
nneighbors <- 100
rd <- nneighbors * 23
kn <- (nneighbors * 6) + 1
input <- data.frame(spatialCoords(spe))
input$barcode <- spe$barcode
input$Cluster <- spe$NerveID
input$sample_id <- spe$sample_id

for (smp in unique(input$sample_id)) {
  inp <- input[input$sample_id == smp,]
  cons <- getContacts(input=inp,rad=rd,knn=kn)
  cons <- cons[is.na(cons$Cluster) & !is.na(cons$Contact_Celltype),]
  cons <- cons[cons$Freq>0,]
  cons <- cons[!duplicated(cons$barcode),]
  out[[smp]] <- data.frame("barcode"=cons$barcode,
                           "BorderID"=cons$Contact_Celltype,
                           "sample_id"=smp
  )
}

add2 <- Reduce(rbind,out)
spe$NerveProximal <- spe$barcode %in% add2$barcode
```

```{r}
# ---- Save the final annotation table --------------------------------------
write.csv(data.frame(colData(spe)), file.path(TABLES_DIR, "nerveID.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved:", file.path(TABLES_DIR, "nerveID.csv"), "\n")
cat("This is a HISTORICAL COMPUTE STEP -- do not re-run casually. See\n")
cat("nerve_identification_figures_cleaned.Rmd for regenerating figures\n")
cat("from this file without risking renumbering.\n")
```
